objective: learn an explicit-right postclose, action-causal eight-frame residual correction on top of the immutable same-request v169 parent using real same-context simulator prefix targets, while keeping left and gate0 requests bitexact to v169

superseded_staging_s0_contract.required_execution_preflight: the obsolete path and SHA must be absent from the remote pipeline, registry, execution closure, release, and launcher; any reference is a hard NO-GO

episode_grouped_outer5.source: the immutable selection.fold field, selected using public actions only before temporal RGB existed
episode_grouped_outer5.validation_use: compute immutable accept/reject metrics only; no checkpoint selection, threshold tuning, architecture choice, learning-rate choice, retry, or sample weighting

architecture_candidates_considered_befor.full256_recurrent_unet: rejected without temporal-result inspection because recurrent self-conditioning and full-resolution activations increase memory, training time, and episode-level overfit risk on only 200 contexts
architecture_candidates_considered_befor.fit_only_pca_or_knn_residual: rejected without temporal-result inspection because prior public-train endpoint evidence showed branch-scale discontinuity and the method cannot represent smooth prefix-dependent spatial transport reliably
architecture_candidates_considered_befor.chosen: frozen-v169 same-request baseline plus one compact shared 128px prefix-causal FiLM residual U-Net; chosen for explicit action causality, bounded capacity, deterministic nonrecurrent execution, and feasible 5090 cost
architecture_candidates_considered_befor.single_candidate_rule: do not train or compare another architecture, channel count, loss weight, step count, residual scale, or input variant under this lineage

v169_cache_contract.same_context_seed: int.from_bytes(sha256('v482-v169-cache/seed1624/episode{episode}/start{start}').digest()[:8], 'little') modulo 2**31; identical for all five branches of one context

context_construction.authoritative_source: for each immutable temporal200 row, read that row's stored pre_future_context_rgb only under the authoritative temporal NPZ schema: exact dtype uint8, exact shape[6,8,256,256,3], C-contiguous canonical bytes, with branch axis in frozen order factual,no_transport,scale_0p4,scale_1p25,reverse_direction_0p4,factual_duplicate and prefix axis k1..k8; verify row NPZ/receipt and the full array SHA256 before use
context_construction.redundancy_identity_gate: before extracting P, require np.array_equal(pre_future_context_rgb[b,k],pre_future_context_rgb[0,0]) for every b=0..5 and k=0..7; all 48 HWC arrays must be bitexact, not merely numerically close; any mismatch hard-stops before v169/cache/model use and is never filtered or repaired
context_construction.construction: let P=pre_future_context_rgb[0,0], preserving exact uint8 HWC[256,256,3] bytes; construct the v169 request context only as np.repeat(P[None,:,:,:],5,axis=0), yielding C-contiguous uint8[5,256,256,3]; every one of the five frames must be byte-identical to P
context_construction.same_for_branches: the one constructed five-frame context is reused byte-identically for factual,no_transport,scale_0p4,scale_1p25,reverse_direction_0p4 of that row; branch RGB targets, source-window RGB, endpoint RGB, recursive predictions, or factual_duplicate must never be used to construct v169 context
context_construction.execution_preregistration_closure: before cache generation, bind for all 200 rows in selection order: row identity, source NPZ path/SHA256, full pre_future_context_rgb uint8[6,8,256,256,3] array SHA256, redundancy_identity_gate result and 48/48 equality count, extracted P uint8[256,256,3] SHA256, constructed repeat-five uint8[5,256,256,3] context SHA256, plus a canonical ordered-manifest SHA256 over these fields; independently reload, check 48/48, reconstruct, and rehash all 200 rows in execution preflight
context_construction.runtime_equivalence: runtime accepts the official uint8[5,256,256,3] request context unchanged; the repeat-five rule is specifically the public temporal-row training/cache construction needed to match that interface and does not authorize altering live request context
context_construction.failure: any missing key, full-array shape/dtype/order/contiguity mismatch, any of 48 arrays not bitexact to [0,0], unequal repeat-five frame, row/full-array/P/context SHA mismatch, or use of another RGB source hard-stops before the first v169 call

v169_cache_contract.request: the exact repeat-five context defined above, canonical history, branch future, canonical instruction, explicit-right arm, and frozen seed; scalar predict only
v169_cache_contract.output: uint8 RGB [200,5,8,256,256,3] in the exact request order, plus per-request SHA256 and a canonical ordered manifest digest
v169_cache_contract.head_sharing: for a query context/branch/frame, the identical branch-specific v169 B_b is supplied to action, context-only, and phase-shuffle heads; a control never substitutes donor v169 pixels or calls v169 with donor actions
v169_cache_contract.storage: volatile /dev/shm cache is allowed and expected; bind its manifest and array SHA256 in receipts, unload v169 and empty CUDA cache before residual training, and do not require the large cache in the final release
v169_cache_contract.determinism: same release, scalar interface, seed, order, dtype, context/action bytes, and instruction must reproduce the cache bitexact; otherwise fail before training
v169_cache_contract.cache_failure: hard stop; no partial-cache training, microbatch substitution, batch-interface retry, or seed change

chosen_model.name: v482_prefix_causal_film_residual_unet128
chosen_model.runtime_gate: active only for explicit-right requests whose history[-1,13]<0.5 and whose full requested future[:,13] is finite and entirely <0.5; all other left or gate0 requests return same-request v169 full8 uint8 RGB bitexact

runtime_request_and_order_contract.instruction_canonicalization: canonical_instruction=str(instruction) exactly once; forward this identical canonical_instruction to v169 and set parser_value=canonical_instruction.lower(); no separate `or ''` conversion is permitted
runtime_request_and_order_contract.explicit_right_parser: explicit_right=(literal substring 'right arm' is present in parser_value and literal substring 'left arm' is absent); do not strip, tokenize, regex-match, translate, infer arm from actions, or use episode/fold/selection metadata
runtime_request_and_order_contract.scalar_shapes: context exactly uint8[5,256,256,3], history finite numeric[4,14], future finite numeric[8,14], seed losslessly convertible to scalar int, instruction converted exactly with str(instruction)
runtime_request_and_order_contract.scalar_order: validate request, compute canonical_instruction once, call frozen v169.predict exactly once with the unchanged context/history/future/int(seed)/canonical_instruction, validate uint8[8,256,256,3] baseline, evaluate parser_value and the strict postclose gate on the original unnormalized actions, and invoke the residual model only if both are true
runtime_request_and_order_contract.batch_shapes: N>=1; context[N,5,256,256,3], history[N,4,14], future[N,8,14], seeds[N], and exactly N instructions
runtime_request_and_order_contract.batch_execution: strict serial loop for index=0..N-1 calling the exact scalar predict_one_with_baseline path; never call a batched v169 interface and never reorder, bucket, deduplicate, parallelize, or share RNG/state across rows
runtime_request_and_order_contract.batch_return: np.stack scalar baselines and scalar outputs in original index order; decision list remains in original index order
runtime_request_and_order_contract.required_exactness_smokes: for a frozen mixed left/right/g0 request set, scalar outputs equal serial batch outputs bit-for-bit; any preregistered batch permutation followed by its exact inverse equals the unpermuted output/decisions bit-for-bit; repeated scalar and batch calls with identical request+seed are bitexact
runtime_request_and_order_contract.fail_closed: any shape, dtype, finite, scalar/batch, permutation, parser, seed-forwarding, or v169-output mismatch aborts release validation; no fallback parser or alternate batch path

visual_preprocess.context: the immutable single pre-future context RGB, float32 /255, fixed 2x2 area average to 128x128
visual_preprocess.baseline: same-request v169 B_k uint8, float32 /255, fixed 2x2 area average to 128x128
visual_preprocess.channels: concatenate [context128, B_k128, B_k128-context128] for exact 9 channels

prefix_causal_conditioner.action_values: history[4,14] plus future[8,14] =168 values, normalized by the exact action_normalization_contract below; no unbound or recomputed-at-runtime statistics are permitted

authoritative_source.scope: the 200 frozen selected public-train contexts only; concatenate each context's authoritative history[4,14] and the five unique branch futures[8,14] in selection order and fixed branch order factual,no_transport,scale_0p4,scale_1p25,reverse_direction_0p4; factual_duplicate is excluded
authoritative_source.allowed_information: public action arrays and their immutable identities only; no RGB, target, reward, success, outcome, dev, final, or hidden data

action_normalization_contract.canonical_source_array: float32 C-contiguous array with shape[200,44,14], preserving IEEE bytes after the selection's already-frozen canonical action conversion; future execution preregistration must materialize and bind this full array SHA256 plus the ordered row manifest SHA256 before any target/cache/model load
action_normalization_contract.bounds_arrays: lower[14]=columnwise minimum and upper[14]=columnwise maximum over the canonical source array, accumulated by exact NumPy float32 min/max in dimension order0..13; write little-endian float32 lower then upper bytes and bind their SHA256 and each 14-value decimal/hex representation in the execution preregistration
action_normalization_contract.bound_before_execution: this design contract fixes the source SHA and derivation, but does not authorize execution; absence or mismatch of the materialized canonical source array SHA, ordered manifest SHA, lower/upper values, or lower||upper SHA in the later execution preregistration is a hard NO-GO
action_normalization_contract.nonzero_span_formula: for dimension j with upper[j]>lower[j], normalized=float32(2*((clip(float32(x),lower[j],upper[j])-lower[j])/(upper[j]-lower[j]))-1); clip is applied independently to every history/future value for training, controls, validation, and runtime, and per-dimension below/above clip counts are reported
action_normalization_contract.zero_span_fit_source_guard: when materializing normalization evidence, every value in the canonical 200x44x14 public-train source for any dimension j with upper[j]==lower[j] must equal that bound bitexact; mismatch fails before any RGB/cache/model load and no epsilon or widened bound is allowed
action_normalization_contract.zero_span_training_and_oof: training and OOF requests are the frozen selected source/branches and must independently satisfy the same exact-bound guard; emit exact float32 +0.0 for their zero-span normalized feature
action_normalization_contract.zero_span_runtime_formula: after the scalar request finite check and without changing the runtime gate, for a runtime/S1 request value x in a zero-span dimension, record whether float32(x) is below/equal/above the frozen bound, deterministically clip it to lower[j]==upper[j], and emit exact float32 +0.0; do not divide, add epsilon, widen/recompute the bound, or reject an otherwise legal finite request solely because x differs from the fit-source constant
action_normalization_contract.right_gripper_guard: dimension13 must materialize from the frozen 200 postclose training source with lower==upper==0.0 or the lineage stops; deployment still evaluates postclose on the original unnormalized finite gripper values using history[-1,13]<0.5 and all requested future[:,13]<0.5, so a legal value such as 0.2 remains gate-active, then dimension13 is normalized by zero_span_runtime_formula to exact +0.0
action_normalization_contract.forbidden: no standard-deviation scaling, epsilon span, learned normalization, per-fold bounds, per-branch bounds, target-informed bounds, extrapolation, or runtime bound update

prefix_causal_conditioner.future_masking: for target frame k, set every normalized future row with one-based index >k to exact float32 zero before the MLP
prefix_causal_conditioner.prefix_mask: eight float32 bits, one for rows <=k and zero after k
prefix_causal_conditioner.scalars: k/8 and postclose-prefix bool(history[-1,13]<0.5 and all future[:k,13]<0.5)
prefix_causal_conditioner.prohibitions: no future action after k, branch id, fold, episode, selection order, RGB-derived gate, reward, or target statistic
prefix_causal_conditioner.mlp: Linear(178,256), SiLU, Linear(256,192), split into gamma[96] and beta[96] at the U-Net bottleneck; initialize the last layer to exact zero
prefix_causal_conditioner.film_formula: after the first 96-channel bottleneck residual block, apply exactly x_film = x * (1 + gamma[:,:,None,None]) + beta[:,:,None,None], with gamma/beta cast to x dtype; zero-initialized final MLP layer therefore makes FiLM the identity, never x*gamma+beta

unet.operations: 3x3 convolutions, GroupNorm with min(8,channels) groups, SiLU, residual blocks, stride-2 convolution downsampling, nearest-neighbor 2x upsampling followed by 3x3 convolution; no bilinear backward, dropout, BatchNorm, attention, recurrence, or stochastic layer
unet.encoder: stem 9->16; residual16; down16->32; residual32; down32->64; residual64; down64->96; two residual96 bottleneck blocks; after the first bottleneck block apply the prefix_causal_conditioner.film_formula exactly once
unet.decoder: nearest2+conv96->64, concatenate encoder64 and residual64; nearest2+conv64->32, concatenate encoder32 and residual32; nearest2+conv32->16, concatenate encoder16 and residual16; final 3x3 conv16->3
unet.output: float32 low-resolution residual tanh(z) in normalized RGB units, expressible range [-1,1] with no target clipping

reconstruction.active_frames: all eight frames may change only when runtime_gate is true
reconstruction.inactive_exactness: left and gate0 return the original v169 uint8 array without conversion, copy, resize, or model invocation

three_head_training_and_controls.same_capacity: three independent copies of the exact chosen model, initialized from one common state_dict SHA256 for each fold
three_head_training_and_controls.shared: same branch-specific B_b, target, context, prefix k, gate scalars, batch sequence, optimizer hyperparameters, step count, precision, and loss
three_head_training_and_controls.action: use the true query history and prefix-masked true query future
three_head_training_and_controls.context_only: set exactly the 168 normalized history/future action values to float32 zero while retaining the query prefix mask, k/8, postclose-prefix scalar, visual input, and B_b
three_head_training_and_controls.phase_shuffle: within the fit portion of each outer fold and the query phase bin, sort contexts by (episode,start,selection_order); for each query choose the first cyclic donor from a different episode, retain the same branch and k, replace only the donor's 168 normalized history/future values, apply the query prefix mask, and retain query context/B_b/target/mask/k/postclose/gate
three_head_training_and_controls.shuffle_freeze: write every query->donor identity, source action SHA256, and the canonical donor-index array SHA256 before loading target RGB

loss.domain: continuous normalized 128x128 RGB reconstructed prediction versus fixed 2x2-area-downsampled simulator target
loss.multiscale: mean of L1 after fixed 2x2 and 4x4 area pooling, weight 0.10
loss.forbidden: perceptual/reward loss, adversarial loss, target clipping, branch-specific weights, validation-driven weighting, or loss-weight sweep

optimizer_and_schedule.precision: fp32 master weights and optimizer; bf16 autocast forward/backward; loss accumulation fp32
optimizer_and_schedule.batch: two complete context-branch sequences, sixteen prefix frames
optimizer_and_schedule.fold_schedule: one exact epoch over 160 fit contexts x five unique branches; stable seed1624 SHA permutation; every sequence appears exactly once; action/context/shuffle use identical order
optimizer_and_schedule.all200_schedule: only after complete S0 PASS, one exact epoch over 200x5 sequences using the same seed/order formula and action head only
optimizer_and_schedule.checkpoint_selection: none; fold metrics use exact final step400, release uses exact final all200 step500
optimizer_and_schedule.determinism: PYTHONHASHSEED=0, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), fixed seeds, no bilinear backward; any nondeterministic operation error is a hard failure

prediction_names.context_control: the identical B_b plus context-only-head residual
prediction_names.shuffle_control: the identical B_b plus phase-shuffle-head residual

s0_metrics.continuous_mae: sum absolute full256 continuous RGB error divided by element count, accumulated float64; use repeat2 residual reconstruction without uint8 rounding
s0_metrics.uint8_mae: sum absolute runtime uint8 RGB error divided by element count, accumulated float64
s0_metrics.ratio: ratio of aggregate error sums, never mean of per-sample ratios; a zero baseline denominator passes only if candidate numerator is also exact zero
s0_metrics.causal_cosine: for factual-anchored pairs to each of four nonfactual branches, compare flattened target correction difference ((Y_b-B_b)-(Y_f-B_f)) to predicted action-residual difference; among pairs with target norm>1e-8, report fraction with strictly positive cosine
s0_metrics.distinct_action_nonzero: fraction of the same 200x4 OOF pairs whose predicted action-residual difference L2 is >1e-8
s0_metrics.episode_improved: an episode improves only when its aggregate OOF candidate continuous error is strictly below its aggregate branch-v169 error

additional_temporal_and_no_catastrophe_g.prefix_causality_counterfactual: for every runtime smoke request and k, changing only future action rows after k must leave the action-residual lowres frame k bitexact
additional_temporal_and_no_catastrophe_g.justification: the public-train aggregate candidate must improve materially while no prefix regresses against v169; the 1.05 episode ceiling prevents aggregate gains from hiding a catastrophic episode and remains a diagnostic S0 cap, while the later frozen S1 first8/recursive gates stay stricter

fold_level_gates_exact.01_continuous_over_frozen_branch_v169: within the fold's 40 held-out contexts, sum candidate continuous absolute error over all five weighted branches, all8 prefixes, pixels and channels divided by the identically aggregated branch-specific v169 error; require ratio<=0.95
fold_level_gates_exact.02_uint8_over_frozen_branch_v169: same held-out rows and aggregation after the frozen runtime rint/clip/uint8 assembly; require ratio<=1.0
fold_level_gates_exact.03_factual_branch: continuous candidate/v169 aggregate ratio restricted to factual branch across all8 prefixes; require<=1.0
fold_level_gates_exact.04_each_counterfactual_branch: compute four separate all8 continuous candidate/v169 aggregate ratios for no_transport,scale_0p4,scale_1p25,reverse_direction_0p4; require every one<=0.98, with no averaging across branches
fold_level_gates_exact.05_action_over_context_only: all-five-branch/all8 continuous action-head aggregate absolute error divided by the identically aggregated context-only-head error using the exact same branch-specific B_b; require<=0.95
fold_level_gates_exact.06_action_over_phase_shuffle: all-five-branch/all8 continuous action-head aggregate absolute error divided by the identically aggregated phase-shuffle-head error using the exact same branch-specific B_b; require<=0.97
fold_level_gates_exact.07_positive_target_delta_cosine: use the metric_definition.causal_cosine factual-anchored 40x4 held-out pairs with target norm>1e-8; require strictly-positive-cosine fraction>=0.60
fold_level_gates_exact.08_distinct_action_prediction_nonzero: use the metric_definition.distinct_action_nonzero over the same held-out 40x4 pairs; require fraction>=0.95
fold_level_gates_exact.ratio_common_rule: all ratios are ratios of float64 aggregate sums under metric_definition.ratio; zero denominator passes only with exact-zero numerator

fold_pass_and_early_stop.fold_pass: all eight explicitly named fold_level_gates_exact, every-prefix and no-catastrophe gates, finite checks, and exact control construction pass
fold_pass_and_early_stop.global_pass: at least 4/5 folds pass, all aggregate ten gates pass, at least 12/15 episodes improve, and every exactness/runtime smoke passes
fold_pass_and_early_stop.second_failed_fold: hard stop immediately because 4/5 is unreachable; do not train remaining folds, all200, runtime, or package
fold_pass_and_early_stop.nonfinite_prediction_loss_gradient_metri: hard stop immediately before classifying the current fold as PASS or FAIL; atomically write a nonfinite/closure failure receipt and do not count it as a failed fold, do not continue another fold, do not retry under this lineage, and never allow NaN/Inf comparison semantics to enter any gate

resources.cpu: taskset CPUs 0-11, six total data/BLAS threads, never unbounded CPU workers
resources.process_cleanup: on timeout, error, OOM, or failed gate, terminate process group, bounded join, KILL and join, atomically write failure receipt, verify no child/GPU process remains, then restore v218 and verify both health endpoints

release_boundary_after_s0_pass.package: exact all200 step500 candidate checkpoint, action normalization bounds, architecture config, v169 closure, runtime, contract, execution preregistration, cache manifest digest, S0 report/audit, trainer/prepare/auditor/packager sources, and a canonical release manifest/tree digest
release_boundary_after_s0_pass.runtime: one same-request v169 call returns B[8], then the deterministic action residual model modifies all8 only under the strict explicit-right/postclose gate
release_boundary_after_s0_pass.s0_pass_authorizes: package and statically audit one immutable public-train parent release, then prepare a separate one-shot public S1 preregistration

future_s1_contract_frozen_now.right: 32 action-only selected right samples x four recursive eight-frame chunks; same-request v169 and v482 receive identical action chunks, seeds, instructions, and each parent's own recursive context
future_s1_contract_frozen_now.left: 12 action-only selected left first8 samples for exactness only, excluded from right quality and reward ratios
future_s1_contract_frozen_now.action_shuffle: retain true query context, same-request true-action v169 B, target, gate, seed, instruction, prefix masks, and assembly; replace only the residual head's 168 normalized action values with preregistered same-phase donors
future_s1_contract_frozen_now.freeze_before_rgb: identities, source hashes, action hashes, phase labels, seeds, actual postclose 32x4 mask, and shuffle donor/features SHA256
future_s1_contract_frozen_now.reward: load the official reward exactly once only after target/v169/true/shuffle RGB arrays and decisions are immutable and hashed
future_s1_contract_frozen_now.on_fail: freeze immutable candidate-fail receipt; no retry, zero-update, training, or RL
future_s1_contract_frozen_now.on_pass: authorize only the materialization of a separate raw-Pi0.5 zero-update preregistration; it does not directly launch the trace or authorize RL

future_raw_pi05_zero_update_contract_fro.blocked_until: the separate immutable S1 receipt passes every gate
future_raw_pi05_zero_update_contract_fro.policy: fresh raw official Pi0.5, frozen, zero policy updates
future_raw_pi05_zero_update_contract_fro.same_request_pair: record policy requests once; save same-request v169 and v482 final RGB; parent choice never generates, changes, filters, or selects policy actions
future_raw_pi05_zero_update_contract_fro.reward: freeze all paired RGB first, then load official reward exactly once
future_raw_pi05_zero_update_contract_fro.formal_rule: any later formal RL must use a separate fresh raw-Pi0.5 official fixed-budget preregistration and explicit authorization; diagnostic v169 policy lineage is never formal
